newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Macau's population rises 13 pct to 454,800.
newsitem.headline: Macau's population rises 13 pct to 454,800.

text.p: Macau's population has increased 12.8 percent to 454,800 people since the last tally in 1991, an interim census released on Thursday by the Portuguese-run enclave showed.
The interim census in the second half of last year found 51.8 percent of Macau's population were female and 48.2 precent male.
More than 91 percent were permanent residents, with most of the other 8.9 percent made up of imported workers from China and the Philippines.
The data also showed there were 3.32 people in the average Macau household compared with 3.45 people in 1991.
